{{BLP sources|date=December 2012}}
'''Trygve Røed-Larsen''' (born 17 May 1939) is a Norwegian physicist.

He graduated with the [[cand.real.]] degree in physics, and took the [[dr.philos.]] degree at the [[University of Oslo]] in 1973. He spent his professional career at the [[Norwegian Defence Research Establishment]] and [[Det Norske Veritas]], and was also a delegate to [[AGARD]]. He has over 100 academic publications, and is a member of the [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]].<ref name=ntb>{{cite news|title=70 år 17. mai: Dr.philos. Trygve Røed-Larsen|agency=[[Norwegian News Agency]]|date=28 April 2009|language=Norwegian}}</ref>

He resides in [[Høvik]].<ref name=ntb/>
